system.description:
Also at 6th level, you have tapped into a latent skill that has been lost to most shinobi. The ability to sense a creature’s presence, even those unseen or unbound by a physical body. You gain a unique special sense known as Shinobi’s Awareness.

Shinobi’s Awareness. As a bonus action you can make a Survival Check using your honed preternatural senses vs the passive Stealth of all creatures in a 60-foot radius of you. For the next minute, you become aware if a creature is observing or targeting you, even if they are invisible, hidden or doing so through extended means (Camera’s, special senses, or jutsu based.) Additionally, all creatures within 60 feet of you that are holding weapons, preparing to attack or experiencing combat induced stress or anxiety alert this sense. This does not reveal their location, but gives you awareness of their presence.

While you have this special sense active, you cannot be surprised or suffer penalties to your initiative rolls.
